title.rendered: Dental Implants | Implant Specialist Dr. Sam

content.rendered:
Regain Your Confidence with Permanent Tooth Replacement in NYC

Are you missing one or more teeth and searching for a permanent solution? At Tribeca Dental Studio, we specialize in dental implants that look, feel, and function just like your natural teeth.

Led by Dr. Sam Morhaim, distinguished periodontist with over three decades of experience in NYC, we combine advanced technology and compassionate care to restore your smile — right here in the heart of Tribeca, Manhattan.

Dr. Sam Morhaim, periodontal surgeon

What Are Dental Implants?

Dental implants are a long-lasting, natural-looking solution for replacing missing teeth. Whether you’ve lost a tooth due to injury, decay, or gum disease, implants offer a permanent fix that promotes long-term oral health.

Each implant includes:

  • A titanium post placed securely in the jawbone
  • An abutment that connects the post to your new tooth
  • A custom-made crown designed to match your smile

Unlike removable dentures or bridges, implants provide superior stability, durability, and help prevent bone loss in the jaw.

Meet Dr. Sam — Implant Dentist in NYC

Choosing the right provider for your implant procedure is crucial. Dr. Sam Morhaim is one of the few implant specialists in New York City with expertise in managing the most intricate implant surgical cases. He’s known for his skill, precision, and compassionate care.

Why Tribeca Dental Studio patients trust Dr. Sam:

  • Full arch Implant expert
  • Thousands of successful implant cases
  • Known for gentle, painless procedures
  • Offers sedation dentistry for a calm, relaxed experience

Why Choose Tribeca Dental Studio for Dental Implants?

We go beyond basic dental care. At Tribeca Dental Studio, we offer a fully customized, state-of-the-art implant experience — whether you’re replacing a single tooth or undergoing a full mouth reconstruction.

What makes us different:

  • Only 49$ prepayment implant consultation
  • 3D CBCT dental scanning for precision
  • Bone grafting & sinus lifts (if needed)
  • Sedation dentistry for pain-free treatment
  • Affordable payment plans & financing
  • Located in the heart of Tribeca, NYC

Fears and Expectations: Let’s Talk About It

We understand — getting a dental implant can feel intimidating. Here’s what most patients worry about, and how we address it:

Will it hurt?

No! We use advanced numbing techniques and offer sedation dentistry. Most patients say the discomfort is minimal to none, even after the procedure.

Is the healing process long?

Implants require a healing period of several weeks for the jawbone to bond with the implant (osseointegration). But you’ll be able to return to work or your routine within 1–2 days.

What if it doesn’t work?

Dental implants generally have a success rate of around 95% — but at Tribeca Dental Studio, our success rate is an outstanding 99.9%.

With over 35 years of experience, Dr. Sam takes a meticulous, individualized approach to every case. Using CBCT-guided implant placement, he carefully evaluates bone quality, gum health, and bite alignment to ensure the highest possible accuracy and long-term results. His attention to detail and advanced planning significantly minimize the risk of implant failure — making him one of the most trusted implant specialists in NYC.

Can I afford it?

We offer flexible payment plans and will work with you to find a solution that fits your budget. Quality care shouldn’t be out of reach.

Let us know your concerns — we’ll listen and guide you through it step by step.

Are You a Good Candidate for Dental Implants?

You might be a great candidate if:

  • You’re missing one or more teeth
  • You want a permanent alternative to dentures
  • You have healthy gums and enough jawbone
  • You’re in overall good health (even if you’re a senior!)

If you’ve lost a tooth years ago, you may still qualify — Dr. Sam offers bone grafting to rebuild jawbone structure.

What to Expect: The Dental Implant Process

Here’s how we transform smiles with dental implants:

What to Expect: The Dental Implant Process

1

Initial Consultation

Meet with Dr. Sam to discuss your goals, take CBCT scans, and receive a customized treatment plan.

2

Implant Placement

The titanium post is gently inserted into the jawbone using minimally invasive techniques. Sedation is available for a worry-free experience.

3

Healing & Osseointegration

Over the next few weeks, your jawbone naturally bonds to the implant — building a strong, long-lasting foundation.

4

Crown Placement

Your final step is the placement of a beautiful, custom-crafted crown that looks and feels just like your natural tooth.

Look at Our Before and After Cases

Here are 3 steps of installing implants

Why Patients Say We’re the Best Dental Implant Clinic in Tribeca

Dr. Sam made the entire process painless and stress-free.

After visiting several offices, I chose Tribeca Dental Studio for their expertise in implants. So glad I did!

The care and results were above and beyond. I smile confidently again.

FAQs

Are dental implants safe for seniors?

Yes! Seniors are often great candidates. Age is not a barrier — health is.

How long do implants last?

With good oral hygiene, dental implants can last 20+ years, often a lifetime.

Can I be sedated during the procedure?

Absolutely. We offer sedation dentistry to keep you relaxed and pain-free.

I lost a tooth years ago — can I still get an implant?

In many cases, yes. We can perform bone grafting if needed to prepare the jaw.

title.rendered: Say Goodbye to Snoring: Discover NightLase Treatment in NYC

content.rendered:
Do you or your partner suffer from loud snoring or restless nights?

Snoring isn’t just a nuisance — it can be a sign of underlying sleep disorders like obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). At Tribeca Dental Studio, we’re proud to offer NightLase® therapy, a revolutionary non-invasive laser treatment designed to reduce snoring and improve your sleep quality — without surgery or bulky devices.

What Is NightLase®?

NightLase® is an advanced laser therapy developed by Fotona, used to gently heat and tighten soft tissues in the throat that contribute to snoring and sleep-disordered breathing. Unlike CPAP machines or oral appliances, NightLase requires no surgery, no anesthesia, and no recovery time.

The procedure uses Fotona’s LightWalker® laser system, which is safe, effective, and pain-free. In just a few short sessions, most patients report a significant reduction in snoring and deepe, more restful sleep.

What Is NightLase®?

NightLase works by:
  1. Applying gentle laser energy to the tissues of the soft palate and uvula.
  2. This energy stimulates collagen production and tightens the tissues.
  3. Tighter tissues result in a more open airway, which significantly reduces vibrations that cause snoring.

The treatment is completed in 3 sessions over a period of 6 to 9 weeks, and results can last up to a year or longer. Best of all? There’s no downtime — you can resume your normal routine immediately after each visit.

Benefits of NightLase® Therapy

  •  Non-invasive & pain-free

  •  No anesthesia or surgery

  •  Quick sessions (30–45 minutes)

  •  Immediate results for many patients

  •  Long-lasting improvement in sleep quality

  •  Safe, FDA-cleared technology

Who Is NightLase Right For?

NightLase is ideal for people who:

  • Snore regularly or loudly
  • Have mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea
  • Struggle with CPAP machines

Want a non-invasive solution for better breathing and rest

BEFORE | AFTER TREATMENT

Real Patients, Real Results

"I had tried mouthguards and CPAP, but nothing worked. NightLase changed my life — I finally sleep through the night, and my partner is grateful too!" Patient At Tribeca Dental Studio

Ready to Sleep Better? Book Your NightLase Consultation Today

If you’re ready to improve your sleep and reduce snoring without surgery, NightLase at Tribeca Dental Studio is your solution.

📍 Schedule your consultation now:

You deserve to wake up refreshed and full of energy — and so does your partner. Let’s help you both get the rest you need.

Is NightLase safe?

 Yes. NightLase is FDA-cleared and clinically proven to be a safe, non-invasive way to treat snoring.

How long do the results last?

 Results typically last up to 12 months. We recommend touch-up sessions as needed.

Does insurance cover NightLase?

 In most cases, NightLase is not covered by insurance, but we offer flexible payment options and financing.

title.rendered: Best Teeth Whitening NYC – Whitening Experts Guide

content.rendered:
Achieving a brighter, whiter smile in NYC begins with choosing a dental team that values safety, results, and your long-term oral health. At Tribeca Dental Studio, our expert cosmetic team delivers professional teeth whitening treatments that go beyond over-the-counter solutions — combining advanced technology with personalized care for visibly radiant results.

Located in the heart of downtown Manhattan, Tribeca Dental Studio offers a comfortable environment, modern techniques, and a patient-first approach. Whether you’re prepping for a big event or simply want to refresh your smile, our whitening services are safe, effective, and tailored to your goals.

Professional Teeth Whitening Manhattan – Discover the Tribeca Glow

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we offer in-office and take-home whitening options using the most trusted systems in cosmetic dentistry. Our in-office whitening treatments use light-activated technology to lift years of stains — often brightening teeth by up to 8 shades in just one visit.

Our expert team customizes every session to your enamel sensitivity, tooth shade, and desired outcome. We ensure your comfort throughout and provide post-whitening guidance to help maintain your results.

Safe & Effective Whitening – Clinical Precision, Cosmetic Brilliance

Unlike store-bought whitening kits, our treatments are overseen by trained professionals who understand the science of smile aesthetics. We use pH-balanced gels, protective barriers, and high-grade ingredients to deliver dramatic results without compromising tooth structure or gum health.

From stubborn coffee stains to natural discoloration, our whitening systems break down deep-set stains while keeping your teeth strong and healthy.

Whitening + Cleaning Combo – Your Brightest Smile Yet

Many of our patients combine their whitening with a professional dental cleaning for optimal results. Removing plaque and surface buildup before whitening allows for more even, longer-lasting whitening effects.

Book a single appointment for both services and leave with a fresh, polished, and luminous smile — ideal for weddings, interviews, or everyday confidence.

Affordable, Accessible Cosmetic Dentistry in NYC

Premium teeth whitening doesn’t have to come at a premium price. At Tribeca Dental Studio, we believe everyone deserves a smile they feel proud of. We offer competitive pricing, flexible payment plans, and guidance on financing if needed. While whitening isn’t typically covered by insurance, we make it as accessible as possible for every patient.

Whitening for Sensitive Teeth – Customized Comfort

If you’ve experienced sensitivity with other whitening products, you’re in the right place. We offer customized solutions, including low-sensitivity gel options and fluoride treatments to minimize discomfort. Your comfort is our priority — and so is delivering safe, lasting results.

Teeth Whitening Options at Tribeca Dental Studio

  • In-Office Whitening: Fast, powerful results in just one session

     

  • Take-Home Whitening Kits: Custom trays and professional-strength gel for flexible at-home whitening

     

  • Touch-Up Treatments: Maintain brightness after your initial treatment with quick, affordable sessions

Combo Packages: Cleaning + Whitening bundled for the ultimate smile upgrade

Prevention + Whitening – Keep Your Smile Bright for Life

Maintaining your whitening results is easy with good oral hygiene, regular cleanings, and lifestyle adjustments. Our hygienist and cosmetic teams provide tips and support to help you preserve your glow — from avoiding stain-causing foods to recommending whitening-friendly toothpaste and touch-up schedules.

Meet Our Whitening Specialists at Tribeca Dental Studio

Our cosmetic team combines advanced training with an artistic eye to deliver beautiful, natural-looking results. Whether it’s your first time whitening or you’re returning for a refresh, you’ll receive expert guidance, supportive care, and exceptional results at every visit.

FAQs

How long does in-office whitening take?

Most treatments take about 60–90 minutes for a full whitening session.

How white will my teeth get?

Results vary, but many patients see their smile brighten by 6–8 shades in one session.

Is teeth whitening safe?

Yes — when performed by professionals. We use proven systems that are gentle, effective, and enamel-safe.

What if I have sensitive teeth?

We offer low-sensitivity whitening solutions and pre-treatment options to minimize discomfort.

Can I combine whitening with cleaning?

Absolutely! Many patients do both in one appointment for a complete smile refresh.

Is whitening covered by insurance?

Most dental insurance plans do not cover cosmetic whitening, but we offer flexible payment options.

title.rendered: Prophy-Jet Polishing in Tribeca, NYC

content.rendered:
At Tribeca Dental Studio, we’re proud to offer advanced tools that elevate your dental experience — and Prophy-Jet polishing is one of our favorites. Whether you’re due for a routine cleaning or want to refresh your smile, this air-polishing technology gives you a gentler, more effective clean.

What Is Prophy-Jet?

Prophy-Jet is a high-tech air-polishing device that uses a gentle stream of water, air, and fine sodium bicarbonate powder to remove soft plaque, surface stains, and debris from your teeth. It’s a more comfortable, efficient alternative to traditional polishing — especially helpful for patients with sensitive teeth or dental work.

Because it uses a soft, controlled stream, Prophy-Jet polishing is suitable for most patients, including those with sensitive teeth or dental restorations. The process not only enhances your smile’s appearance but also contributes to better gum health and overall oral hygiene.

Teeth Polishing: Traditional vs. Prophy-Jet

Traditional teeth polishing involves a rubber cup and gritty paste to scrub away stains. While effective, this approach can sometimes cause mild discomfort, especially for patients with sensitive teeth or gum inflammation.

Prophy-Jet Polishing, in contrast, uses controlled bursts of air, water, and polishing powder to lift away surface debris with minimal pressure. It provides a deeper clean in less time, reaching difficult spots between teeth and along the gumline. Patients often describe the experience as smoother, cleaner, and more comfortable, with an instantly brighter smile.

Benefits of Prophy-Jet Polishing for Patients

Choosing Prophy-Jet Polishing in Tribeca, NYC comes with several advantages for your oral health and comfort:

  • Gentle and Non-Abrasive Cleaning: Ideal for patients with tooth or gum sensitivity.
  • Effective Stain Removal: Erases stains from coffee, tea, wine, and tobacco.
  • Improved Gum Health: Helps remove bacterial buildup and reduces inflammation.
  • Fresher Breath: Cleans plaque and odor-causing debris for a cleaner mouthfeel.
  • Faster, More Comfortable Treatment: Saves time without compromising results.
  • Perfect Prep for Whitening: Smooth surfaces help whitening treatments work more effectively.

This approach ensures you leave Tribeca Dental Studio with teeth that not only look radiant but also feel healthier.

Why We Use It at Tribeca Dental Studio

Our hygiene team uses Prophy-Jet because it:

  • Lifts stains caused by coffee, tea, wine, or smoking
  • Reduces sensitivity with a softer touch
  • Reaches tough areas around braces, implants, or tight spaces
  • Leaves your teeth feeling ultra-smooth and refreshed

Our team customizes each polishing session to your oral health needs, ensuring optimal results with minimal discomfort.

Who Can Benefit from Prophy-Jet Polishing?

Prophy-Jet polishing is versatile and suitable for nearly everyone who wants to maintain a bright, healthy smile. It’s especially beneficial for:

  • Patients with Braces or Retainers: Cleans around wires and brackets where traditional tools can’t reach.
  • Those with Sensitive Teeth: Gentle airflow minimizes discomfort and irritation.
  • Individuals with Veneers, Crowns, or Implants: Safe for cleaning around dental restorations.
  • Patients Focused on Preventive Care: Regular treatments help prevent plaque buildup and early gum issues.

No matter your dental history, our team ensures the process is safe, effective, and tailored to your comfort.

Is Prophy-Jet Polishing Safe for Sensitive Teeth or Dental Restorations?

Yes, Prophy-Jet Polishing is safe and gentle for patients with sensitive teeth and for those who have veneers, crowns, or implants. The fine polishing powder used during the process won’t scratch or damage restoration surfaces.

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we customize the air pressure and powder type based on your unique dental needs, ensuring every patient enjoys a comfortable experience without compromising results.

What to Expect During Your Visit

During your cleaning appointment at Tribeca Dental Studio, your hygienist will first remove any hard tartar. Then, they’ll use the Prophy-Jet to gently spray away soft plaque and stains.

You’ll feel a cool, refreshing sensation as surface stains and plaque are lifted away. The treatment is followed by a thorough rinse, leaving your teeth smooth and bright. You’ll leave the office with noticeably cleaner, smoother teeth — and without the gritty feeling of traditional polishing pastes.

How Often Should You Get Prophy-Jet Polishing?

For most patients, we recommend Prophy-Jet polishing during your routine cleaning visits every six months. However, if you frequently consume coffee, red wine, or tobacco or wear orthodontic appliances, more frequent sessions may help maintain your smile’s brightness and cleanliness.

Your Tribeca Dental Studio hygienist will evaluate your oral health and recommend the ideal schedule for your lifestyle and needs.

FAQs

Is Prophy-Jet safe for people with sensitive teeth?

Yes! Prophy-Jet is much gentler than traditional polishing methods. It uses a soft stream of water and fine powder, making it ideal for patients with sensitive teeth or gums.

Does Prophy-Jet whitening replace professional teeth whitening?

No, Prophy-Jet doesn’t whiten teeth the way bleaching does, but it effectively removes surface stains, making your smile appear brighter and cleaner.

How long does a Prophy-Jet cleaning take?

The air polishing itself usually takes just a few minutes. It’s part of your full hygiene appointment, which typically lasts 45 minutes to an hour.

Does Prophy-Jet polishing hurt?

No, most patients find Prophy-Jet Polishing much gentler and more comfortable than traditional polishing methods. The air-and-water stream cleans teeth without harsh scraping, making it ideal for those with sensitive gums or mild dental anxiety.

Can I get Prophy-Jet polishing if I have veneers or crowns?

Absolutely. Prophy-Jet Polishing is safe for veneers, crowns, bridges, and implants. The fine polishing powder and adjustable air pressure allow our hygienists to clean effectively without scratching or damaging your restorations, leaving them smooth and spotless.

How long do the results last after Prophy-Jet polishing?

The bright, polished feeling from Prophy-Jet Polishing typically lasts until your next professional cleaning. Avoiding coffee, tea, wine, and tobacco can help maintain your results longer and keep your smile looking fresh between visits.

Is Prophy-Jet polishing suitable for children?

Yes, Prophy-Jet Polishing is gentle enough for most children, depending on their comfort and dental needs. The process is quick, effective, and non-abrasive, making it an excellent option for keeping young smiles clean and healthy.

Schedule Your Prophy-Jet Polishing in Tribeca, NYC

Ready for a cleaner, brighter smile with less sensitivity? Schedule your Prophy-Jet Polishing appointment at Tribeca Dental Studio today. Our skilled hygienists combine advanced air-polishing technology with gentle care to give you the most comfortable and effective cleaning possible.

Book your visit online or call our office to see why patients across New York City trust us for modern preventive dental care, and leave every visit smiling brighter than ever.

title.rendered: Best Teeth Cleaning NYC | TDS Hygienist Team Guide

content.rendered:
Finding the best teeth cleaning in NYC starts with choosing a team that prioritizes your health, comfort, and long-term wellness. At Tribeca Dental Studio, our experienced hygienists deliver premium cleanings that go beyond just polishing teeth — we focus on prevention, education, and care tailored to your unique needs.

Located in the heart of downtown Manhattan, Tribeca Dental Studio offers world-class technology and a compassionate approach. Our hygienists utilize ultrasonic scalers, digital imaging, advanced diagnostic tools, Prophy-Jet air polishing, and laser therapy when needed to ensure your smile stays healthy, clean, and confident. Whether it’s your first visit or a routine checkup, we make every cleaning session thorough, gentle, and informative — removing plaque, surface stains, and hard-to-reach buildup with precision and comfort.

Professional Dental Cleaning Manhattan – Experience the Tribeca Difference

At Tribeca Dental Studio, our professional dental cleanings combine cutting-edge tools with warm, personalized care. Our skilled hygienist team performs comprehensive evaluations, plaque and tartar removal, Prophy-Jet polishing, and oral health coaching — so you leave not only with a brighter smile but also with better habits and peace of mind.

We understand the fast pace of city life. That’s why our team is trained to deliver efficient, effective cleanings without compromising quality. Our patient-focused approach ensures a seamless experience from start to finish.

Prophy-jet polishing was explained in video

Affordable Yet Premium Teeth Cleaning – Accessible Excellence

Premium care doesn’t have to be out of reach. While we are based in Manhattan, Tribeca Dental Studio is committed to making high-quality dental cleanings accessible. We offer flexible payment options, accept most major PPO dental insurance plans, and ensure you understand every step of your treatment plan before we begin.Premium care doesn’t have to be out of reach. While we are based in Manhattan, Tribeca Dental Studio is committed to making high-quality dental cleanings accessible. We offer flexible payment options, accept most major PPO dental insurance plans, and ensure you understand every step of your treatment plan before we begin.

Deep Cleaning for Advanced Needs – Specialized Periodontal Care

When standard cleanings aren’t enough, our hygienists collaborate with our in-house periodontal specialists to provide deep cleaning (scaling and root planing). For optimal comfort and healing, we use the Biolase Waterlase® laser — a gentle, precise tool that targets bacteria below the gum line without damaging healthy tissue.

Combined with ultrasonic scalers and meticulous monitoring, our laser-assisted cleanings help reduce inflammation, improve healing times, and protect your gum and bone health. Whether you’re managing early-stage gum disease or advanced periodontal issues, you’re supported every step of the way.

Whitening + Cleaning – For a Healthier, Brighter Smile

Many of our patients choose to combine their professional teeth cleaning with in-office whitening treatments. After plaque and surface stains are removed, we safely whiten your teeth — often by up to 8 shades in a single session — with no damage or sensitivity.

Prevention is Power – Regular Cleanings with Our Hygienist Team

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we believe preventive care is the foundation of lifelong oral health. Our hygienists focus on more than just cleaning — we screen for early signs of gum disease, tooth decay, and oral cancer. With every visit, we share practical education and tips tailored to your lifestyle to help maintain your results long-term.

Advanced Biofilm Removal with Periodt® Sulfonated Phenolics

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we go beyond traditional cleaning techniques by incorporating advanced products like Periodt® Biofilm Debridement Sulfonated Phenolics. This innovative formula is designed to effectively break down and remove stubborn biofilm—a sticky layer of bacteria that can accumulate on teeth and gums, leading to plaque buildup and gum disease.

Periodt®’s sulfonated phenolics solution enhances our hygienists’ ability to thoroughly clean areas that are difficult to reach with standard tools. When combined with ultrasonic scaling and Prophy-Jet polishing, it helps ensure a deeper, more effective cleaning while promoting a healthier oral environment.

Using products like Periodt® aligns with our commitment to leveraging the latest dental science to protect your smile and maintain long-term oral health.

Meet the Hygienist Team at Tribeca Dental Studio

Our hygienist team is the heart of our practice. With years of experience, a gentle touch, and compassionate communication, they make every visit welcoming and stress-free. Whether it’s your first cleaning or your fiftieth, you’re always in expert hands at Tribeca Dental Studio.

FAQs

How often should I get my teeth cleaned?

Every 6 months is ideal — or more frequently if recommended by your hygienist.

Do your hygienists use ultrasonic technology?

 Yes! We use ultrasonic scalers, Prophy-Jet polishing, and laser tools for a safe, thorough, and comfortable cleaning experience.

Can I combine cleaning with whitening in the same visit?

Absolutely! Many patients schedule both for a full smile refresh in one appointment.

Do you accept insurance?

Yes, we accept most major PPO dental insurance plans and will help you understand your benefits before treatment.

What makes your hygienists different?

They blend clinical excellence with a warm, patient-centered approach that keeps our patients coming back.

title.rendered: Crowns, Bridges, and Implants: What’s the Difference?

content.rendered:
If you’re dealing with missing teeth, broken teeth, or damaged dental work, you’re not alone—and you’re not without options. At Tribeca Dental Studio in New York City Dr. Igor Chikunov, our board-certified prosthodontist and NYU College of Dentistry graduate, helps patients restore their smiles using modern, durable solutions like crowns, bridges, and dental implants.

But which one is right for you? Here’s a quick breakdown from Dr. Chikunov to help you understand the differences.

Dental Crowns: Strength and Protection for Weakened Teeth

A crown is a tooth-shaped cap that fully covers a damaged or weakened tooth to restore its shape, strength, and function. Crowns can be made from porcelain, ceramic, or zirconia for a natural look and long-lasting durability.

Ideal for patients who have:

  • Large cavities or fractures
  • Root canal-treated teeth
  • Worn or misshaped teeth
  • Cosmetic concerns

Dr. Chikunov’s tip:

“Crowns not only restore function, they can dramatically improve the appearance of a tooth—especially in the front of the mouth.”
Tweet

Dental Bridges: Filling the Gap from Missing Teeth

A bridge literally “bridges” the gap left by one or more missing teeth. It’s made up of one or more artificial teeth, anchored on either side by crowns placed on adjacent healthy teeth.

Best for:

  • Patients missing 1–2 teeth in a row
  • Those who may not be ready for implants
  • Restoring bite balance and preventing teeth from shifting

Dr. Chikunov explains:

“Bridges are a time-tested solution. They’re fixed in place and restore both chewing ability and your smile.”
Tweet

Dental Implants: Permanent Tooth Replacement

A dental implant is a titanium post surgically placed into the jawbone to replace the root of a missing tooth. It’s topped with a crown or denture and functions just like a natural tooth.

Ideal for:

  • Patients missing one or more teeth
  • Those looking for a permanent, non-removable solution
  • Preventing bone loss in the jaw

Dr. Chikunov emphasizes:

“Dental implants are today’s gold standard. They look, feel, and function like natural teeth and can last a lifetime with proper care.”
Tweet

How to Know What’s Right for You

Choosing between a crown, bridge, or implant depends on several factors:

  • The number of missing or damaged teeth
  • Bone health and gum condition
  • Budget and personal preferences
  • Long-term goals for oral health

That’s why Dr. Chikunov offers personalized consultations to discuss your options and create a custom treatment plan.

Key Benefits of Visiting a Prosthodontist:

  • Specialized training in tooth restoration and replacement
  • High-end aesthetic and functional outcomes
  • Expertise in complex full-mouth cases

FAQs

How long do dental crowns, bridges, or implants last?

With proper care, dental crowns and bridges can last 10–15 years, while implants can last a lifetime. Regular dental check-ups and good oral hygiene are essential.

Are dental implants painful?

Most patients report only mild discomfort after implant surgery, similar to a tooth extraction. Dr. Chikunov uses modern techniques and gentle care to ensure a smooth recovery.

What’s the difference between a bridge and an implant?

A bridge is supported by adjacent teeth, while an implant is surgically placed in the jawbone and stands alone. Implants help prevent bone loss, while bridges are a quicker, non-surgical option.

Visit Dr. Igor Chikunov at Tribeca Dental Studio

Whether you need to restore a single tooth or your entire smile, Dr. Igor Chikunov brings years of prosthodontic expertise and precision to every case. From state-of-the-art materials to aesthetic excellence, your smile is in expert hands.

Schedule your consultation today and let us help you smile with confidence again.

title.rendered: All-on-4 Dental Implants In Tribeca, NYC

content.rendered:
Are you struggling with missing teeth or uncomfortable dentures? At Tribeca Dental Studio, we offer a life-changing solution — the All-on-4® dental implant system — a permanent, natural-looking full-arch restoration that can give you back your confidence, function, and quality of life.

What is All-on-4?

The All-on-4® treatment concept is a revolutionary approach to full-mouth restoration. Using just four dental implants, we can securely anchor a full set of teeth — usually in one day. This advanced technique avoids the need for bone grafting in most cases and provides immediate function with a beautiful smile.

How Our Clinic Does It Differently

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we take pride in offering personalized, comprehensive care using state-of-the-art technology. Our All-on-4 procedure is done in a streamlined, patient-centered process, including:

  • Comprehensive consultation and 3D imaging

We evaluate your bone structure and smile design using the latest digital technology.

  • Expert surgical placement 

Implants are placed at strategic angles to maximize support and avoid complex grafting procedures.

  • Same-day smile

In most cases, patients leave with a fixed, natural-looking provisional set of teeth on the same day of surgery.

  • Final prosthesis after healing

Once your implants integrate fully, you’ll receive your permanent custom-crafted teeth designed for comfort, function, and aesthetics.

Why Choose Dr. Sam for Your All-on-4 Procedure?

Our All-on-4 cases are led by Dr. Sam, a periodontist, which means you’re in the care of a highly trained dental specialist with advanced expertise in gum health, implant surgery, and bone reconstruction.

Dr. Sam’s meticulous attention to detail, experience in complex cases, and passion for helping patients restore their smiles set our clinic apart.

Benefits of All-on-4 at Our Clinic

  • Minimally invasive, graftless solution in many cases
  • Immediate improvement in function and aesthetics
  • Long-lasting results with proper care
  • Personalized care with a skilled surgical and prosthetic team

Ready to Smile Again?

If you’ve been told you’re not a candidate for traditional implants, or if you’re tired of dealing with loose dentures, the All-on-4 solution might be the answer. Schedule a consultation with Dr. Sam today and take the first step toward a confident, fully functional smile.

What are All-on-4 dental implants

All-on-4 is an advanced dental implant solution that replaces a full arch of teeth using just four strategically placed implants. It provides a permanent, stable, and natural-looking alternative to traditional dentures.

How is All-on-4 different from traditional implants?

Unlike traditional implants that may require 6–8 implants per arch and bone grafting, All-on-4 uses only four implants placed at special angles to maximize support — often eliminating the need for grafting and reducing healing time.

Who is a good candidate for All-on-4?

Most patients who are missing multiple teeth or wearing dentures are potential candidates — even those who’ve been told they don’t have enough bone for traditional implants. A 3D scan and consultation with Dr. Sam will determine your eligibility.

Will I get my new teeth the same day as surgery?

Yes, in most cases. Patients leave our office with a secure, natural-looking provisional set of teeth the same day as their implant surgery. The final set is delivered after full healing and integration.

All-on-4 Dental Implants Explained by Dr. Sam | Tribeca Dental Studio

title.rendered: Laser Gum Treatment Disease NYC

content.rendered:
Laser Gum Treatment offers a painless, contemporary solution to gum disease. The treatment uses cutting-edge dental lasers to destroy infected tissue, kill bacteria, and enable gums to heal on their own. Tribeca Dental Studio patients choose this treatment due to its comfort, effectiveness, and success.

Unlike traditional surgery, Laser Gum Treatment is minimally invasive. There’s no cutting, no stitches, and less discomfort during recovery. Patients with bleeding gums, gum recession, or deep pockets benefit most.

If you’re struggling with gum issues, Laser Gum Treatment may be your answer. Our expert periodontists deliver safe, targeted care using state-of-the-art laser technology.

Dr. Sam Morhaim, a board-certified periodontist with nearly 30 years of experience, is the primary provider of advanced laser gum treatments at Tribeca Dental Studio.

  • Board-certified periodontal surgeon

  • Specializes in minimally invasive laser therapy

  • Expert in treating moderate to severe gum disease

  • Offers All-on-4, bone grafts, and regenerative procedures

What is Laser Gum Treatment?

It’s a non-surgical gum disease treatment with the application of precise laser energy. The
diseased tissue and bacteria are removed by the laser without being aggressive

How laser therapy works for gums

How laser gum therapy is done is simple—lasers kill bacteria far beneath the gums, cleanse,
and support healing without hurting healthy tissue.
How laser gum therapy works also enhances comfort, reduces the danger of infection, and
stops future dental problems.

Bleeding gums

Bleeding gums indicate infection. When gums bleed upon brushing, laser treatment may be
the fastest and most secure option.
Early-treated bleeding gums heal quickly and reduce the chance of severe gum disease.

Arrange a Consultation with Our NYC Periodontist

Schedule an Appointment with Our NYC Periodontist to decide whether laser gum treatment
is right for you. Early treatment leads to better outcomes.

Is laser gum therapy safe?

Yes, it’s FDA-approved and safe for most patients.

How long will it take to see results?

Improvement is typically seen in days to weeks.

Who is eligible for laser gum treatment?

Anybody with gum disease, mild, moderate, or advanced.

title.rendered: Early Signs of Gum Disease You Should Never Ignore

content.rendered:
LANAP® vs. Osseous Surgery: Which Is Right for You?

If you’ve been diagnosed with moderate to advanced periodontal disease, your periodontist may recommend either LANAP® or osseous (flap) surgery, depending on your specific case.

Here’s how the two compare:

LANAP® Laser Therapy vs. Osseous (Flap) Surgery

Aspect LANAP® Laser Therapy Osseous (Flap) Surgery
Invasiveness Minimally invasive; uses a laser to target diseased tissue without cutting or stitches Surgical procedure involving cutting and suturing of gum tissue
Healing Time Faster healing with little to no downtime Longer healing period with potential swelling and discomfort
Pain/Discomfort Typically mild; most patients return to normal activity the same day May require prescription pain medication and recovery time
Tissue Preservation Selectively removes only infected tissue, preserving healthy gums May involve removal of some healthy gum tissue to access infection
Bone Regeneration Stimulates natural bone regeneration through laser biostimulation Aims to reshape or reduce damaged bone rather than regenerate it
Ideal For Patients seeking a less invasive, modern, no-suture solution with faster recovery Patients with advanced or complex infections requiring open access surgery

LANAP® is ideal for patients looking for a gentler, modern approach to treating gum disease—especially those nervous about traditional surgery or who want to avoid sutures.

Osseous surgery may still be recommended in more severe or complex cases where access to deep infection is necessary.

During your consultation at Tribeca Dental Studio, Dr. Sam Morhaim will help you understand which treatment is best for your unique situation.

Explore our LANAP® Laser Gum Therapy in NYC

When it comes to your oral health, your gums are just as important as your teeth. Yet gum disease (also known as periodontal disease) often goes unnoticed—until it’s too late. The early warning signs are easy to miss, but if caught in time, gum disease can be treated and even reversed.

In this post, we’ll break down the early symptoms of gum disease you should never ignore—and what you can do if you’re experiencing them.

What Is Gum Disease?

Gum disease is a bacterial infection of the tissues that support your teeth. It starts as gingivitis, a mild form of gum inflammation, and can progress into periodontitis, a more serious condition that leads to gum recession, bone loss, and eventually tooth loss.

The good news? Gum disease is preventable and treatable, especially when caught early.

Early Signs of Gum Disease

If you notice any of the following symptoms, it’s time to take action:

1. Red, Swollen, or Tender Gums

Healthy gums should be firm and pink. If your gums are red, puffy, or sensitive to touch, it could be one of the first signs of gingivitis.

2. Bleeding When You Brush or Floss

A little blood when brushing isn’t “normal”—it’s a sign of inflammation. Bleeding gums are one of the most common early warning signs of gum disease.

3. Bad Breath That Won’t Go Away

Chronic bad breath (halitosis) or a bad taste in your mouth can indicate an infection lurking beneath your gumline.

4. Gums That Pull Away From Your Teeth

Do your teeth look longer than they used to? That could be gum recession, which often accompanies periodontitis. As gums pull away, pockets form—creating a breeding ground for bacteria.

5. Sensitive Teeth

Increased tooth sensitivity—especially to hot or cold—can occur when gum tissue recedes and exposes tooth roots.

6. Loose or Shifting Teeth

This is a red flag that gum disease may have already damaged the bone that supports your teeth. Immediate treatment is critical.

Learn more about our comprehensive periodontal disease treatment in NYC designed to restore gum health and protect your natural smile.

What to Do If You Notice These Signs

If you’re experiencing any of these symptoms, don’t wait. Schedule an evaluation with a periodontist—a dentist who specializes in treating gum disease and supporting structures of the teeth.

Learn more about our gum disease treatment options

Can Gum Disease Be Reversed?

In the early stages (gingivitis)—yes! With proper cleanings and consistent oral care, you can often reverse the damage. Once it progresses to periodontitis, the condition is manageable, but not fully reversible. That’s why early detection is key.

How to Prevent Gum Disease

  • Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste
  • Floss once a day
  • Visit your dentist regularly for cleanings
  • Avoid tobacco products
  • Eat a balanced diet rich in vitamins and minerals

Here is the video tutorial how to keep gums clean

Don’t Wait—Protect Your Smile Today

The earlier you act, the easier gum disease is to treat—and the better your long-term oral health will be. Located in the heart of Tribeca, our team at Tribeca Dental Studio offers advanced periodontal care in a calm, compassionate setting. Schedule your gum evaluation today Or call us at (212) 561-5303.

title.rendered: Palatal Expansion for Children: A Non-Surgical Way to…

content.rendered:
Pediatric Airway Health | Sleep &Orthodontics

When most parents think of orthodontics, they picture braces and straight teeth — but palatal expansion for airway and tonsil reduction in children is quickly becoming one of the most impactful treatments in pediatric health care. A new study shows that expanding the palate may actually help reduce enlarged tonsils, adenoids, and improve breathing and sleep — all without surgery. But new research from Stanford and UCSF reveals that Rapid Palatal Expansion (RPE) — a common orthodontic treatment — can do much more than align smiles. It may actually help reduce enlarged adenoids and tonsils, which are a major cause of snoring, mouth breathing, and sleep apnea in children

Why Are Adenoids and Tonsils a Big Deal?

Enlarged adenoids and tonsils — also called adenotonsillar hypertrophy — can block a child’s airway and contribute to sleep-disordered breathing (SDB). 

This ranges from mild snoring to full-blown obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), which is linked to poor school performance, behavior problems, and even heart issues.

The usual solution? Surgery. But what if orthodontic care could help?

What the Study Found

A 2022 study published in Sleep Medicine followed 60 children aged 5 to 15, comparing those who received RPE with those who did not. The results were remarkable:

      • 90% of kids who got RPE had a reduction in adenoid size
      • 97.5% had smaller tonsils after treatment
      • On average, tonsils shrank by 38.5% and adenoids by 16.8%
      • Some kids saw up to 75% tonsil shrinkage

    Sleep-related symptoms (like snoring and restless nights) significantly improved

    How Does Palatal Expansion Help the Airway?

    RPE widens the upper jaw using a small orthodontic appliance. This:

      • Improves nasal airflow by expanding the nasal passages

      • Raises tongue posture, which helps open the throat

      • Reduces inflammation in the lymphatic tissues (like adenoids and tonsils)

      • Encourages nasal breathing instead of mouth breathing, restoring natural airway defenses

    This creates a healthier environment in the airway — less irritation, less swelling, and better sleep.

    Should My Child Try RPE?

    If your child:

      • Breathes through the mouth

      • Snores or sleeps poorly

      • Has a narrow palate or crowded teeth

      • Has enlarged tonsils or adenoids

    …they may benefit from an airway-focused orthodontic assessment.

    At Tribeca Dental Studio, we specialize in early interceptive orthodontics that supports not just the smile — but your child’s breathing and development. RPE is a non-surgical treatment that may help your child avoid tonsil/adenoid surgery altogether.

    How MARPE Enhances Airway Health

    Systematic reviews and clinical trials show that MARPE:

      • Increases nasal cavity width (~2 mm) and volume significantly pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov+2mdpi.com+2pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov+2progressinorthodontics.springeropen.com+8bmcoralhealth.biomedcentral.com+8apospublications.com+8.

      • Enlarges nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal volumes, easing airway space researchgate.net+15bmcoralhealth.biomedcentral.com+15apospublications.com+15.

      • Reduces nasal resistance, improving airflow from day one researchgate.net+3pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov+3mdpi.com+3.

      • Boosts sleep quality in OSA patients—one adult study found 65% drop in AHI, reduced daytime sleepiness, and better oxygen saturation after MARPE researchgate.net+4progressinorthodontics.springeropen.com+4en.wikipedia.org+4.

    These volumes and functional gains create a more open, stable airway—an ideal foundation for growth, breathing, and sleep.

     

    Study Citation

    Yoon A, Abdelwahab M, Bockow R, et al. Impact of rapid palatal expansion on the size of adenoids and tonsils in children. Sleep Med. 2022 Apr;92:96–102. doi: 10.1016/j.sleep.2022.02.011

title.rendered: Pediatric Dental Services in New York: Complete Guide for Parents

content.rendered:
Pediatric Dental Services in New York offers dental services specifically designed to cater to children’s dental requirements. The services intend to create favorable experiences that help children develop healthy oral hygiene habits from an early stage of life. Trained and skilled pediatric dentists know child psychology and use techniques relevant to the patient’s age to make dental visits comfortable and relaxing.

The New York pediatric dental clinic provides a spectrum of treatment modalities, from simple cleaning procedures to complex procedures. Pediatric Dental Services New York provides preventive, restorative, and emergency services for children. Specialty clinics offer child-friendly settings with cheerful decorations, toys, and entertainment systems to alleviate anxiety and provide a pleasurable visit.

The importance of choosing qualified Pediatric Dental Services in New York cannot be overestimated when your child’s future oral health is concerned. Pre-emptive work with the dentist prevents serious complications and establishes lifelong foundation habits. Trained pediatric dentists also receive additional training beyond general dentistry, specializing in treating infants, children, and adolescents and understanding children’s development and growth patterns.

Children’s Dentist NYC: Finding the Right Professional

Children’s dentist NYC experts undergo training to offer age-appropriate dental treatment in a non-intimidating atmosphere. These experts know children need to be handled differently than adults and seek ways to make dental treatment a fun and educational experience and less of a scary ordeal.

Selecting the Best Children’s Dentist in NYC means conducting background checks on credentials and reviews and scheduling consultations. Opt for dentists who possess patience, excellent communication skills, and a willingness to work with young children in their clinic.

Pediatric Orthodontics New York: Early Intervention Benefits

New York Pediatric Orthodontics treatments fix children’s teeth alignment and jaw development. Through early evaluation by experts, they can determine potential problems before they develop into serious conditions, hence a reduced treatment time and enhanced results.

Professional New York Pediatric Orthodontics specialists recommend early evaluations at the age of seven. This allows for the monitoring of development and treatment at a time when it will be most beneficial and least disruptive for children.

Kids Dental Care Manhattan: Comprehensive Treatment Options

Kids Dental Care Manhattan provides a full spectrum of services designed to maintain and improve youngsters’ oral health. Regular cleaning, fluoride, sealants, and restoration work are all adapted to meet the comfort and cooperation level of young children.

Quality Kids Dental Care Manhattan professionals emphasize prevention and education, teaching children how to brush correctly and eat right and how important frequent checkups and dental visits are to a healthy life.

Emergency Pediatric Dentist: When Urgent Care is Needed

Emergency Pediatric Dentistry provides emergency treatment for tooth trauma, pain, or any other oral problems requiring a high level of emergency care. These experts know how frightening dental emergencies can be to children and parents.

The availability of qualified Emergency Pediatric Dentist services assures prompt response in the event of an emergency. Promptness and timely emergency action avoid complications from dental trauma and reduce pain.

Sedation Dentistry for Children: Anxiety Management Solutions

Children’s Sedation Dentistry offers safe solutions to alleviate dental anxiety and provide relaxing treatment experiences. These solutions include sedation ranging from minimal to general anesthesia, depending on the child’s needs and procedure complexity.

Trained Sedation Dentistry for Children practitioners closely follow each patient’s history and anxiety level. Tailor-made care ensures a safe sedation procedure while following safety standards.

Preventive Dental Care Kids: Building Healthy Foundations

Preventive Dental Care Children programs are designed to keep teeth and mouths healthy with regular checkups, cleanings, and education. These services enable any problems to be found early when treatment is simpler and less expensive.

Effective Preventive Dental Care for Children comprises dental sealants, fluoride treatments, and nutrition counseling. These procedures substantially reduce the risk of cavities and other oral problems in childhood.

Tooth Extraction for Children: When Removal is Necessary

Tooth Extraction in Children may be needed due to severe decay, overcrowding, or injury that cannot be treated by any other means. Pediatric dentists use specialized methods to minimize pain and anxiety associated with the procedure.

Professional Tooth Extraction in children requires careful planning in advance and post-extraction care instructions. This maximizes healing and minimizes the risk of tooth extraction complications.

Dental Anxiety Treatment Kids: Creating Positive Experiences

Dental Anxiety in Children Treatment programs provide for common fears and concerns children have about going to a dentist. These targeted procedures use behavior change techniques, diversionary techniques, and graduated exposure to reduce anxiety.

Effective Dental Anxiety Treatment Kids programs allow children to develop positive attitudes toward dental treatment. This establishes a foundation for lifelong oral care and routine professional care.

At what age should my child first visit a pediatric dentist?

Children should visit a pediatric dentist by age one or within six months of first tooth eruption.

How often should children have dental checkups?

Most children should have dental checkups and cleanings every six months for optimal oral health maintenance.

What makes pediatric dentists different from general dentists?

Pediatric dentists receive specialized training in child psychology, behavior management, and age-specific dental treatments.

Are dental X-rays safe for children?

Modern dental X-rays use minimal radiation and are considered safe when necessary for proper diagnosis.

How can I prepare my child for their first dental visit?

Read dental books, play dentist games, and maintain positive attitudes about dental care experiences.

Primary care from New York Pediatric Dental Services forms the basis of a lifetime of oral wellness. The services provide dental care appropriate to one’s age in a friendly and relaxed atmosphere, from basic preventive care to special procedures. Parents who make expert pediatric dental care a main priority provide their children with the best opportunity to have healthy smiles and good attitudes toward dental care for a lifetime.

title.rendered: Discover the Power of Professional Teeth Whitening at Tribeca Dental Studio

content.rendered:
A bright, confident smile can make all the difference — whether it’s for a special occasion or simply boosting your everyday confidence. At Tribeca Dental Studio, we specialize in professional teeth whitening treatments designed to safely and effectively brighten your smile, revealing a more radiant you.

Why Choose Professional Teeth Whitening?

Over time, teeth naturally darken due to factors like coffee, tea, red wine, smoking, and aging. While over-the-counter whitening products are widely available, they often lack the strength and precision of professional treatments. Our in-office whitening solutions provide:

Fast results: Achieve noticeable whitening in as little as one 90-minute session.

Safety: Treatments are supervised by experienced dental professionals to ensure your enamel and gums are protected.

Customization: Whitening intensity is tailored to your unique teeth and preferences for a natural, flattering result.

What to Expect at Tribeca Dental Studio

When you book a whitening appointment with us, our team will start with a thorough dental examination to ensure your teeth and gums are healthy. We’ll discuss your goals and explain the whitening process, so you feel comfortable and informed every step of the way.

During the treatment, a safe whitening gel is carefully applied, and advanced light technology activates the formula to break down stains effectively. Many patients relax during the procedure and leave feeling refreshed with a noticeably brighter smile.

Maintaining Your New Smile

To help you keep your smile shining long after your treatment, our team will provide personalized advice on at-home care, including recommended products and lifestyle tips to prevent future staining.

Ready to Brighten Your Smile?

If you’re ready to enhance your appearance with a brighter, healthier-looking smile, schedule your professional teeth whitening session at Tribeca Dental Studio today. Our expert team is here to help you shine with confidence.

Contact us or visit our website to learn more about our whitening treatments and other dental services.

title.rendered: The Importance of Early Dental Care: When and Why Your Child Should See a Dentist

content.rendered:
Dental care should never be an afterthought when it comes to your child’s health. While baby teeth may seem temporary, their condition can significantly influence lifelong oral health. Early dental care lays the foundation for healthy smiles, confident development, and overall well-being. Understanding when to start and why it matters can give your child the best chance at a cavity-free, beautiful smile well into adulthood.

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we believe that prevention, education, and compassionate care are at the heart of a successful dental journey. With our expert team in children’s dentistry and orthodontics, we’re proud to guide families across Lower Manhattan in establishing habits that last a lifetime.

Let’s explore the when and why of early dental visits—and how our caring, comprehensive approach at Tribeca Dental Studio makes all the difference.

When Should Your Child First See a Dentist?

According to the American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD), children should have their first dental visit by their first birthday or within six months of the appearance of the first tooth—whichever comes first.

This might seem early, but this proactive approach is essential for several reasons:

  • Early detection of tooth decay or developmental concerns
  • Parental guidance on proper cleaning techniques, diet, and oral habits
  • Familiarization with the dental environment to reduce future anxiety
  • Monitoring of jaw and tooth development

At Tribeca Dental Studio, our pediatric specialists understand how to make your child’s first visit feel relaxed and welcoming. We introduce our young patients to the dental world with warmth, patience, and a gentle touch—helping them build positive associations with oral health from the start.

Why Baby Teeth Matter

Some parents assume that baby teeth aren’t as important since they’ll fall out anyway. However, these primary teeth serve essential functions:

  • Holding space for adult teeth
  • Supporting facial structure and speech development
  • Enabling proper chewing and nutrition
  • Helping children feel confident when they smile

If a baby tooth is lost too early due to decay or injury, surrounding teeth may shift into the vacant space, potentially causing issues with alignment and crowding when permanent teeth erupt. That’s why early attention and routine care are vital.

Our team at Tribeca Dental Studio carefully tracks tooth development and alignment. To support healthy, natural development, we also offer space maintainers and other preventive solutions as part of our children’s dentistry and orthodontics services.

The Power of Preventive Dentistry

Starting dental visits early is not just about treating problems—it’s about preventing them.

Preventive dental care includes:

  • Dental cleanings and exams
  • Fluoride treatments to strengthen enamel
  • Dental sealants to protect cavity-prone molars
  • Oral hygiene education for both children and parents

These simple yet powerful steps can significantly reduce the risk of tooth decay, which is one of the most common chronic conditions in children.

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we empower families with knowledge. Our friendly hygienists and pediatric dentists take the time to educate children and parents alike, tailoring advice to each stage of development.

Spotting and Treating Dental Issues Early

Early dental care allows for the identification of concerns before they become complex or painful. Some common issues that can arise in childhood include:

  • Tooth decay (cavities)
  • Tongue-tie or lip-tie that can interfere with nursing or speech
  • Thumb-sucking or pacifier habits that may affect tooth alignment
  • Enamel defects or discoloration
  • Jaw misalignment or bite issues

Through routine visits, our team monitors changes in your child’s oral development. Should we spot something that needs attention, our in-house pediatric specialists and orthodontists collaborate seamlessly to create a personalized treatment plan.

Tribeca Dental Studio’s all-in-one approach means your family doesn’t need referrals or multiple appointments across the city. Everything you need is right here, under one welcoming roof.

Orthodontics: When to Consider Evaluation

While many parents associate braces with the teenage years, early orthodontic evaluations—often around age 7—can play a crucial role in preventing more serious issues later.

Early intervention can:

  • Guide jaw growth to create space for permanent teeth
  • Correct harmful habits like thumb-sucking or tongue-thrusting
  • Improve bite alignment and prevent overcrowding
  • Reduce the need for future extractions or jaw surgery

Our team at Tribeca Dental Studio offers early-phase orthodontic care, which may include space maintainers, palate expanders, or even limited braces if needed. If full orthodontic treatment becomes necessary in the teenage years, our specialists are ready with advanced, customized solutions for a healthy and confident smile.

A Child-Friendly Experience Matters

One of the biggest barriers to pediatric dental care is anxiety—both in children and parents. That’s why it’s essential to choose a practice that understands and caters to the emotional and developmental needs of young patients.

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we’ve designed our pediatric spaces with comfort, calm, and creativity in mind:

  • A welcoming atmosphere that puts kids at ease
  • Friendly, patient-focused professionals who speak in kid-friendly terms
  • Gentle techniques and distraction strategies to reduce discomfort
  • Positive reinforcement to help kids feel proud of their dental achievements

By fostering a sense of safety and trust, we help children grow into adults who are confident and proactive about their dental health.

Teaching Good Habits That Last a Lifetime

In addition to professional care, children must develop strong at-home habits. Our role as dental professionals is to support and guide families every step of the way. During your child’s visit, we’ll help reinforce:

  • Proper brushing and flossing techniques
  • Nutritional guidance to minimize sugar intake and protect teeth
  • The importance of routine dental visits every six months
  • Mouthguard use for kids involved in sports

When children understand why oral care matters and feel ownership over their routines, they’re more likely to maintain healthy smiles as they grow.

Special Needs Pediatric Dentistry

Every child deserves a positive and respectful dental experience, and we understand that children with special needs may require additional support.

Our pediatric team is experienced in treating children with:

  • Autism spectrum disorders
  • Sensory sensitivities
  • Developmental or cognitive delays
  • Physical disabilities

We work closely with parents and caregivers to create a customized, compassionate, and stress-free care plan because comfort and dignity come first at Tribeca Dental Studio.

The Comprehensive Difference at Tribeca Dental Studio

One of the most unique advantages of choosing Tribeca Dental Studio is our comprehensive, team-based care model. Instead of visiting multiple offices for pediatric checkups, orthodontics, or even specialized treatments like root canals or prosthodontics, you’ll find everything you need in one state-of-the-art location.

Our services include:

  • Pediatric dentistry
  • Children’s orthodontics
  • Preventive and restorative care
  • Periodontal treatments
  • Endodontic work
  • Prosthodontic and cosmetic solutions

And with extended office hours, we make it easy for even the busiest families in Lower Manhattan to prioritize their dental health.

Led by Dr. Nina Izhaky, our team invests in the latest dental technologies and techniques to ensure precise, comfortable, and effective treatment. Whether it’s a toddler’s first cleaning or a teen’s final set of braces, you can trust that your child’s smile is in expert hands.

Why Early Dental Care Matters for Life

Childhood dental care does more than protect baby teeth—it helps shape your child’s future. A healthy mouth contributes to:

  • Better overall health
  • Improved self-esteem
  • Clear speech and effective chewing
  • Fewer dental interventions later in life

When you start early and stay consistent, your child benefits from a confident, radiant smile and the peace of mind that comes from lifelong wellness.

Ready to Give Your Child the Best Start?

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we’re not just here to fix problems—we’re here to prevent them, educate families, and provide expert care in a warm, inclusive, and forward-thinking environment. With a highly trained team across multiple specialties and a commitment to compassionate service, we’re proud to be your partner in children’s dentistry and orthodontics.

Whether your child is ready for their very first appointment or you’re looking for a comprehensive dental home for the whole family, we’re here for you.

title.rendered: The Surprising Link Between Gum Disease and Alzheimer’s: What It Means for Your Brain Health

content.rendered:
At Tribeca Dental Studio, we believe in the profound impact that oral health has on overall wellness. Recent research has brought forward an intriguing link between gum disease and Alzheimer’s disease, revealing new insights that could change the way we think about brain health and oral hygiene.

Gum Disease and Alzheimer’s Disease: A New Connection

New research published in Science Advances suggests that gum disease, or more specifically, a harmful bacterium called Porphyromonas gingivalis, may play a role in the development of Alzheimer’s disease. This bacteria, which is responsible for chronic periodontitis (gum disease), was found in the brains of deceased Alzheimer’s patients. The discovery has raised a critical question: could poor oral health contribute to the onset of Alzheimer’s?

If you’re struggling with gum inflammation or bleeding gums, seeking periodontal disease treatment early can help protect both your smile and your long-term health.

What the Study Found

The study revealed that when mice were infected with Porphyromonas gingivalis, the bacteria not only colonized their gums but also traveled to their brains. There, it triggered the production of amyloid beta—a protein often associated with Alzheimer’s disease. This discovery provides further evidence for the theory that Alzheimer’s may have infectious origins, as opposed to being purely a neurodegenerative disorder.

Even more surprising, researchers found toxic enzymes from the bacteria in the brains of individuals who had Alzheimer’s-related brain changes but hadn’t been diagnosed with dementia yet. This suggests that the infection could begin years before noticeable symptoms of Alzheimer’s appear, meaning that gum disease might be a contributing factor to the disease long before it’s diagnosed.

What This Means for You

This research highlights the importance of oral hygiene in not just protecting your teeth but also in potentially preventing neurological conditions like Alzheimer’s. While more studies are needed to fully understand the link between gum disease and Alzheimer’s, the connection emphasizes a key takeaway: healthy gums and teeth are more important than ever for your overall health.

Taking care of your gums is critical, and here at Tribeca Dental Studio, we’re committed to providing the best care to help you prevent gum disease. Regular brushing, flossing, and routine dental check-ups are simple steps you can take to protect your oral health—and potentially your brain health.

Keeping up with routine dental checkups and teeth cleaning can significantly reduce bacteria buildup that contributes to gum disease and inflammation.

Potential New Treatments: A Glimmer of Hope

In light of these findings, researchers are hopeful that future treatments could focus on both reducing bacterial infection and amyloid beta accumulation in the brain. One such potential treatment, developed by the pharmaceutical company Cortexyme, is a compound called COR388.

This treatment has shown promise in reducing both bacterial infections and amyloid beta in animal studies. Though human trials are still needed, it signals a potential breakthrough in Alzheimer’s research. For patients with advanced gum infection, advanced laser options such as LANAP® Laser Gum Therapy offer a modern, minimally invasive way to treat periodontitis and preserve natural tissue.

The Takeaway: Protect Your Teeth, Protect Your Brain

While we are still in the early stages of understanding how gum disease may contribute to Alzheimer’s, this research underscores an essential message: oral hygiene matters more than ever. Keeping your gums healthy may not only protect your smile but could also support your long-term brain health.

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we encourage all of our patients to prioritize their oral health. Don’t wait for symptoms to appear—regular check-ups can help prevent gum disease and its potential effects on your overall health. Let’s work together to keep your smile—and your mind—healthy for years to come.

Learn more about the full research and its findings here: Read the full research

title.rendered: 5 Signs Your Child Might Need Braces: A Parent’s Guide

content.rendered:
As a parent, you want the best for your child, and that includes a healthy, confident smile. But how do you know if your child needs braces? With so much information out there, it can be hard to know when to take action or if those crooked teeth are just part of growing up.

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we understand that the decision to get braces for kids is a big one, and we’re here to help you every step of the way. Our team of experienced pediatric dentists and orthodontists specialize in making the process as smooth and comfortable as possible, ensuring that your child achieves a beautiful, healthy smile they can be proud of.

Ready to learn more? Here are five signs that your child might need braces and how Tribeca Dental Studio can help.

1. Why Early Detection Is Important

Before diving into the signs, it’s essential to understand why early detection and intervention are crucial for your child’s dental health.

The Importance of Early Orthodontic Evaluation

According to the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO), children should have their first orthodontic evaluation by age 7. Why so early? At this age, children typically have a mix of baby teeth and permanent teeth, making it easier for orthodontists to identify potential issues and plan effective treatment.

Benefits of Early Detection

  • Prevents More Serious Problems: Early intervention can prevent more severe dental issues down the road, potentially reducing the need for more invasive treatments.
  • Guides Jaw Growth and Alignment: Correcting issues early helps guide the growth of the jaw and alignment of the teeth, ensuring a more natural development.
  • Improves Oral Health and Function: Proper alignment makes it easier to clean teeth, reducing the risk of cavities and gum disease.
  • Boosts Confidence and Self-Esteem: A healthy, attractive smile can significantly improve your child’s confidence and social interactions.

Tribeca Tip: Don’t wait until all the baby teeth are gone—early evaluation can make all the difference. You ask. We answer!

2. Crowded or Crooked Teeth

One of the most obvious signs that your child might need braces for kids is crowded or crooked teeth.

Why It Happens

Crowded or crooked teeth occur when there isn’t enough space in the jaw for all of the teeth to fit correctly. This can be due to:

  • Genetics: If you or your spouse needed braces, your child is more likely to need them too.
  • Early or Late Loss of Baby Teeth: Losing baby teeth too early or too late can affect the alignment of permanent teeth.
  • Jaw Size and Shape: An irregularly shaped jaw can lead to crowded or crooked teeth.

Why It’s a Problem

  • Difficulty Cleaning Teeth: Overlapping or tightly packed teeth can make it challenging to brush and floss effectively, increasing the risk of cavities and gum disease.
  • Improper Bite: Crooked teeth can cause an improper bite, leading to chewing difficulties and excessive wear on the teeth.
  • Speech Problems: In some cases, misaligned teeth can affect speech development.

How We Can Help

At Tribeca Dental Studio, our pediatric orthodontists specialize in diagnosing and treating crowded or crooked teeth using custom braces or aligners. We tailor each treatment plan to your child’s unique needs, ensuring the most effective and comfortable solution.

Tribeca Tip: If you notice your child’s teeth overlapping or crowding, schedule an orthodontic evaluation with us. You ask. We answer!

3. Overbite or Underbite

An overbite or underbite is another common reason children need braces. These bite issues occur when the upper and lower teeth don’t align properly.

What’s the Difference?

  • Overbite: When the upper front teeth significantly overlap the lower front teeth.
  • Underbite: When the lower front teeth extend beyond the upper front teeth.

Why It Happens

  • Genetics and Heredity: Bite issues are often inherited from parents.
  • Thumb Sucking or Pacifier Use: Prolonged thumb sucking or pacifier use can affect jaw alignment and contribute to an overbite.
  • Jaw Growth Imbalance: Discrepancies in jaw growth can cause misalignment, leading to an overbite or underbite.

Why It’s a Problem

  • Difficulty Chewing and Speaking: An improper bite can make it challenging to chew food properly or pronounce certain words.
  • Tooth Wear and Damage: Misaligned bites can cause uneven wear on the teeth, leading to chipping or cracking.
  • Jaw Pain and TMJ Issues: Severe bite issues can cause jaw pain, headaches, and temporomandibular joint (TMJ) problems.

How We Can Help

Our team at Tribeca Dental Studio uses advanced orthodontic treatments to correct overbites and underbites. We offer a variety of solutions, including traditional braces, clear aligners, and growth modification appliances to guide proper jaw alignment.

Tribeca Tip: If your child has difficulty chewing or their teeth don’t line up when their mouth is closed, it’s time for an evaluation. You ask. We answer!

4. Mouth Breathing and Snoring

Mouth breathing and snoring might seem unrelated to orthodontics, but they can be a sign of dental issues that require braces.

Why It Happens

Mouth breathing and snoring are often caused by:

  • Narrow Jaw or Palate: A narrow jaw or palate can restrict the airway, leading to mouth breathing or snoring.
  • Misaligned Teeth: Misaligned teeth can impact the airway, making it difficult to breathe through the nose.
  • Obstructive Sleep Apnea: In severe cases, structural issues can contribute to sleep apnea.

Why It’s a Problem

  • Affects Oral Health: Mouth breathing can dry out the mouth, reducing saliva production and increasing the risk of cavities and gum disease.
  • Impact on Facial Growth: Chronic mouth breathing can affect the growth of the jaw and facial structure.
  • Sleep Disruptions: Snoring and sleep apnea can lead to poor sleep quality and affect concentration and behavior.

How We Can Help

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we assess the underlying causes of mouth breathing and snoring. Our orthodontists use specialized appliances, such as palatal expanders or braces, to widen the jaw and improve airway function.

Tribeca Tip: If your child frequently breathes through their mouth or snores, schedule an evaluation to identify any underlying issues. You ask. We answer!

5. Thumb Sucking or Tongue Thrusting

Thumb sucking and tongue thrusting are common habits in young children, but if they persist beyond the age of 4-5, they can cause dental problems that require orthodontic treatment.

Why It’s a Problem

  • Affects Bite Alignment: Prolonged thumb sucking can cause an overbite or open bite.
  • Speech Issues: Tongue thrusting can affect speech development and articulation.
  • Misaligned Teeth: These habits can push teeth out of alignment, affecting the bite and appearance.

How We Can Help

Our team at Tribeca Dental Studio uses gentle, effective treatments to correct the effects of thumb sucking and tongue thrusting, including braces and habit-breaking appliances.

Tribeca Tip: Early intervention is key to preventing long-term issues. You ask. We answer!

Why Choose Tribeca Dental Studio for Braces for Kids?

At Tribeca Dental Studio, we specialize in braces for kids and provide a welcoming, child-friendly environment to make every visit comfortable and enjoyable. Here’s why you should choose us:

  • Experienced Pediatric Orthodontists: Our team is skilled in diagnosing and treating orthodontic issues in children.
  • Customized Treatment Plans: We create personalized treatment plans tailored to your child’s needs.
  • State-of-the-Art Technology: We use the latest orthodontic technology for accurate diagnosis and effective treatments.
  • Convenient Location: Located in the heart of Tribeca, we serve families throughout New York City.

Ready to Get Started? Contact Tribeca Dental Studio Today!

If you notice any of these signs, it might be time to explore braces for kids. And luckily, at Tribeca Dental Studio, we’re dedicated to providing expert orthodontic care in a fun, friendly, and welcoming environment.

So don’t wait: contact Tribeca Dental Studio today to schedule your child’s orthodontic consultation.
